name: Stolberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Stolberg (a white lion with a chequy bar on red).
history: Municipal flag of Stolberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Stolberg arms — lion with chequy bar on red
